# Agent Gate Contract (AGC)

> A standard JSON shape for the answer a gate (a hook, a linter, a reviewer or an auditor) gives an AI agent. It is designed to end correction loops: repair before block, the strongest remedy, a check per finding, exhaustive coverage, scoped fingerprints and a bounded attempt budget.

- [SPEC.md](SPEC.md): the normative specification
- [schema/agc.schema.json](schema/agc.schema.json): JSON Schema 2020-12
- [BINDINGS.md](BINDINGS.md): Claude Code hooks, Codex hooks, judgment agents, SARIF
- [EVIDENCE.md](EVIDENCE.md): the measurement behind each rule
- [examples/](examples/): valid, chained and invalid responses
